# World Bank

> The World Bank is a global development institution providing research, financing, and strategic initiatives to reduce poverty and promote sustainable economic growth in developing nations.

The World Bank Group operates through multiple entities including the IFC, focusing on critical areas like food security, energy access, health systems, job creation, and climate resilience. The organization combines flagship reports, research publications, and transformative initiatives to address global development challenges.

## Global Development Initiatives

- [Creating Jobs for a Better Future](https://www.worldbank.org/ext/en/jobs): World Bank Group's global jobs initiative empowering youth, women, and small businesses.
- [Mission 300 is Powering Africa](https://www.worldbank.org/en/programs/energizing-africa): Mission 300 initiative scaling electrification across Sub-Saharan Africa for economic growth.
- [AgriConnect: Agribusiness, Jobs & Subsistence Farming](https://www.worldbank.org/ext/en/agriconnect): World Bank initiative transforming smallholder farming through technical innovation and policy.
- [Health Works](https://www.worldbank.org/en/programs/health-works): World Bank Group program improving health systems and universal health coverage globally.

## Research & Economic Analysis

- [Research](https://www.worldbank.org/en/research): World Bank research hub providing data, publications, and development research expertise.
- [Global Economic Prospects](https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/global-economic-prospects): World Bank's 2026 global economic outlook covering trends, growth, and inflation analysis.
- [Digital Progress and Trends Report 2025: AI Foundations](https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/dptr2025-ai-foundations): Report on AI reshaping economies with affordable Small AI solutions for developing nations.

## Food Security & Water Resources

- [Nourish and Flourish](https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/nourish-and-flourish-water-solutions-to-feed-10-billion-people-on-a-livable-planet): Flagship report on water management in agriculture for sustainable food security by 2050.
- [Rethinking Resilience: Adapting to a changing climate](https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/rethinking-resilience): World Bank analysis on climate adaptation and economic resilience for developing economies.

## Partnerships & Collaboration

- [Partnerships](https://www.worldbank.org/ext/en/work-with-us/partnerships): World Bank Group partnerships page outlining collaboration opportunities and engagement.

## Operations & Procurement

- [Project Procurement](https://www.worldbank.org/ext/en/what-we-do/project-procurement): Procurement framework, guidance, and business opportunities for World Bank projects.

## Optional

- [Annual Report 2025](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/annual-report): World Bank Group's 2025 annual report on organizational performance and strategic priorities.
